sloka: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं वेगेनाभ्युत्पपात ह ।। ६.८८.१ ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।abravīt paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ vegenābhyutpapāta ha ।। 6.88.1 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Vibheeshana's words, Indrajith was deluded with fury, spoke harshly and advanced.
